description.value: Rustic forested Recreation Site where Bear Creek meets Harrison Lake, with drive-in, walk-in forest, and walk-in beach sites; no potable water or flush toilets, cash only, and some low-lying sites flood during spring freshet — bring all your own water and pack out everything. Opens mid-May.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bear Creek is an active Recreation Site on Harrison Lake operated by Greenshades Enterprises, opening May 15, 2026. Multiple website pages (Know Before You Go, FAQ) explicitly state no potable water, no showers, no electricity, and no garbage service, allowing confident false values for those amenities. Reservations are confirmed true via a dedicated reservations page; walk-in tenting-only sites exist but are not explicitly labelled as hiker/biker sites.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website — contact is email only (harrisoneast@hotmail.com, checked Tuesdays).
No physical address in OSM record; remote recreation site with no posted street address.
Very remote and rustic: no potable water, no showers, no electricity, no cell service — touring cyclists must be fully self-sufficient.
First-come-first-served sites are cash only on site; no advance information on availability.
Gates locked 10pm–8am; all visitors must exit by 9:30pm.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active Recreation Site campground on Harrison Lake with walk-in tenting-only sites well-suited for touring cyclists; the rustic, self-sufficient nature of the site should be prominently noted in the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Operated jointly by Greenshades Enterprises and Recreation Sites & Trails BC. Walk-in tenting-only sites (#17–#28) are the most relevant options for cycle tourists. Firewood sometimes available for sale on site but can sell out.

wow_evidence: walk-in beach sites… Bear Creek meets Harrison Lake
